$comment: Mundane light sources (SPEC §34.3), hand-authored from the SRD 5.2.1 PDF. `dim` is the ADDITIONAL dim radius beyond `bright` (the SRD's 'Dim Light for an additional N feet'; the vision engine lights r ≤ bright + dim as dim, SPEC §15.3). Each `verify` phrase must occur on the cited `page` (the build checks it against the PDF text and fails otherwise); `verify` is not copied to the pack.

sources.name: Candle
sources.notes: Lighting it with a Tinderbox takes a Bonus Action (p. 100).
verify: For 1 hour, a lit Candle sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet.

sources.name: Torch
sources.notes: Lighting it with a Tinderbox takes a Bonus Action (p. 100).
verify: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

sources.name: Lamp
sources.notes: Burns Oil; a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern (p. 99). Lighting it with a Tinderbox takes a Bonus Action (p. 100).
verify: A Lamp burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

sources.name: Lantern, Hooded
sources.notes: As a Bonus Action, lower the hood (see hooded-lantern-lowered) or raise it again. A flask of Oil burns for 6 hours (p. 99).
verify: A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

sources.name: Lantern, Hooded (hood lowered)
sources.notes: The hooded lantern with its hood lowered (a Bonus Action to lower or raise).
verify: As a Bonus Action, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.

sources.name: Lantern, Bullseye
sources.notes: Directional: a 60-foot Cone of Bright Light plus 60 feet of Dim Light. Cone angle 53.13° = 2·atan(1/2), from the Cone definition (width at any point equals its distance from the origin, p. 179). A flask of Oil burns for 6 hours (p. 99).
verify: A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 60-foot Cone and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.
